evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Clear, bounded CRUD-style functionality with specified inputs; can be reasonably estimated.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Specific mechanism (URL access) and scope are clear enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Well-scoped UI/data entry behavior; straightforward to size.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: A session item list view is a common, bounded feature; not overly broad.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single, clear interaction (select item) with obvious outcome; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Simple add-to-list behavior; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Standard edit operation on an item; scope is clear enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Standard delete operation; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Clear toggle/command behavior with defined condition; can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Specific computation and action; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Clear condition and outcome; straightforward to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Simple data entry for an estimate; bounded scope.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation within a session is a clear, bounded capability.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Underspecified breadth (file formats, mapping rules, validation, error handling, duplicates) makes implementation effort hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous parsing/format expectations (columns, delimiters, multi-line cells, validation) create broad scope and uncertain effort.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games, so that I can find the previous game I'm looking for
evaluations.rationale: ‘Browse’ and ‘find’ are open-ended (search, filters, pagination, sorting, metadata) leading to unclear scope for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: A transcript view is a bounded read-only display of known entities (stories/estimates); estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Specific export format and artifact; scope is sufficiently clear to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Specific export format; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Clear delete behavior and scope; can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Specified fields and action; standard registration feature is estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Standard login behavior; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Too broad/underspecified (which details, constraints, verification flows like email change, password change) making effort hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Clear delete action and scope; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Single, well-understood behavior (timezone display conversion); estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Common password reset/reminder flow; while details vary, scope is sufficiently bounded to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Clearly defined options and configuration choice; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Specific numeric constraint on an existing capability; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Clear join flow with specified input; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Simple display of current item; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: List view of session items; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Clear UI feedback requirement (status per estimator); estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Defined reveal condition and behavior; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Clear temporal constraint tied to reveal event; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: ‘Prior estimates’ is underspecified (within session vs across games, how many, where displayed), making scope and data needs hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Bounded to current round and specific mapping (estimator→estimate); estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Specific duration and shared visibility; bounded feature and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Clear trigger condition and action; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Bounded to prior rounds within the game/session; a defined navigation/view behavior that can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Specific consistency requirement for ordering; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Clear condition (before draw completion) and action; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Underspecified source/management of photo (upload, external profile, defaults, privacy) makes scope broad and hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Compliance across an entire site is a broad, cross-cutting requirement with unclear boundaries/level of compliance, making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Bounded deliverable (glossary/list); can be estimated even if content evolves.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes, so that the queries run as fast as possible
evaluations.rationale: Scope is open-ended (‘as fast as possible’) and depends on unknown query set/performance targets, making effort hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: ‘Function correctly’ across multiple legacy browsers is broad and potentially large/variable in effort without specifying supported feature set or acceptance scope.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: ‘Where possible’ and guideline coverage level are vague and cross-cutting, making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Non-specific performance requirement without measurable thresholds or scoped actions; too vague to estimate reliably.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Broad, cross-cutting internationalization/storage/display implications are unspecified (where input is accepted, encoding, DB, exports), making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: ‘Sensible and predictable’ is subjective and potentially site-wide, leaving scope unclear for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Vague and potentially broad across many failure cases (‘something goes wrong’, ‘nice’) making scope hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Broad/underspecified privacy/anonymization requirement (what identifiers, threat model, linkage rules) makes implementation effort hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: ‘Some metrics’ is vague and open-ended (which metrics, time ranges, dashboards, aggregation), making estimation difficult.
